model_annotation: This donut chart visually represents the distribution of data across two nested categorical dimensions: “Ambiguity Std (Outer)” and “Max Ambiguity (Inner)”. The outer ring, segmented into four shades of blue, corresponds to standard deviation levels (Std: 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, 0.94), with respective proportions of 49.0%, 47.7%, 7.0%, and 5.0%. The inner ring, divided into three lighter blue shades, reflects maximum ambiguity levels (Max: 1, 2, 3), accounting for 38.0%, 39.0%, and 14.2% respectively. Percentages are labeled directly on each segment, and a dual legend on the right clarifies the color coding for both outer and inner categories. The chart’s concentric design allows for simultaneous comparison of how maximum ambiguity is distributed within each standard deviation group.
